items.code:
def solve(nums, target):
    return [-1, -1] if target not in nums else [nums.index(target), len(nums) - 1 - nums[::-1].index(target)]

judge_a.reason: Uses built-in `in` and `index` methods, not a search algorithm.

judge_b.reason: Uses Python list methods index and reversed index, no binary search or bisect used.

predictions_commit1.lambda_selection_rule: lambda*_t = argmax correct off-default share (among correct) over lambda in {0.25, 0.5, 1} with pass >= 0.8 x pass(twin S1); ties -> smaller; none -> UNTESTED

predictions_commit1.mr_breakage_rule: MR(lambda*) BROKEN if pass < 0.8 x twin (S1, MR(lambda*) cell when run, else the nearest MR grid point); lambda' = the largest grid lambda with an unbroken MR; none -> ISO(1)
predictions_commit1.reverse_rule: default share among correct (primary) and among parseable attempts (co-primary) rises by >= 0.5 x (instruct twin share - base twin share)

predictions_precision_rule.rule: cc >= 8.9 and GiB < 19.5 -> fp8_w8a8; GiB >= 19.5 -> bf16; cc < 8.9 and GiB < 19.5 -> fp8_weight_only
